_question: Heat Sheet (v2.1 composition pass): does each essential state change keep an equivalent non-motion communication under reduced motion? Mappings are from the full-motion carrier to the reduced carrier.

mappings.full: a full-bleed patchwork title card with the project count, cut away tile by tile, once per session
mappings.reduced: not shown; the page and the count in the bar appear directly

mappings.full: spring rotation of the rack; the title's lines drop out of their masks in 200 ms
mappings.reduced: instant reposition; the title is replaced at once; the position number and index row change immediately

mappings.full: the case pulls straight out, turns and floats to the presentation spot (gated springs)
mappings.reduced: the gate sequence resolves within one frame; the case is shown presented

mappings.full: two-plate print: the shell-colour plate rises through the line masks, the ink plate lands on it, the colour plate lifts
mappings.reduced: the ink title is shown at once; the colour plate is not drawn

mappings.full: position, standfirst and meta rise into place in a 60 ms stagger
mappings.reduced: caption text appears at once; the status region announces the case in both modes

mappings.full: front leaf swings on its hinge beside the spread
mappings.reduced: case shown open beside the spread

mappings.full: spread slides in from the right; the quilt is revealed in six steps; the title rises
mappings.reduced: spread shown without movement; focus moves to Close

mappings.full: the index wipes down over the page in 460 ms
mappings.reduced: the index appears at once; focus moves to Find

mappings.full: a cover follows the pointer over the row it is on, with a slight lean
mappings.reduced: the cover sits at the pointer without lag or lean

mappings.full: on filter or sort, cases sink through the floor, re-slot unseen and rise from the front out
mappings.reduced: slots change in place at once; the index shows the new order

mappings.full: a labelled cursor (Drag, Open, View) follows on a short spring
mappings.reduced: the system cursor; the hint in the bar names the gestures

mappings.full: the camera leans a little toward the pointer
mappings.reduced: no lean; the view is fixed

mappings.full: index scrolls smoothly to the current row
mappings.reduced: index jumps to the current row
